changes: Promoted PresentMon 2.5.1 to the current external frame-time authority and made collector-version/raw-evidence comparability explicit because the 2.5 line corrected percentile and frame-metric semantics.
Added an evidence ladder from immutable Mods inventory through PresentMon, ETW, projection experiments, and only then native hooks.
Added a ProjFS pass-through/immutable projection contract, official Windows enablement prerequisite, and exact compatibility/performance acceptance gates.
Added a separately versioned WinFsp fallback lane with stable-versus-2026-beta security/compatibility qualification instead of silently adopting a pre-release filesystem driver.
Added source-recovery and baseline-harness procedures so the unresolved scaffold cannot be mistaken for an implemented accelerator.
Updated the external comparison authority from PresentMon 2.4.1 to 2.5.1 and added raw-evidence/version comparability requirements.
Expanded the first legitimate implementation milestone into a read-only fail-closed diagnostic overlay rather than unverified optimization controls.
Added a 15-step launch/input/device/swap-chain/restart acceptance matrix, timing-semantic mapping, bounded logging, source recovery, packaging identity, and troubleshooting guidance.
Kept Dear ImGui, DirectXTK, MinHook, and Detours as researched candidates rather than claiming adoption before canonical source recovery.
Made PRJ-012 inherit PRJ-011's independent performance evidence authority while keeping the module-versus-separate-product relationship unresolved.
